items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 November 2026 10:33pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 11 November 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the south of Iceland and a deepening area of low pressure running south into the North Sea.


##Wind##

North 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 tonight over central and western parts tonight, then becoming 4 or 5 again in all waters tomorrow afternoon or evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North 4 or 5, backing North or Northwest 3 or 4 overnight into Friday, backing West or Northwest on Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional showers for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.
